description: Start a prototype project for the human you act for: we make the sourcing plan (as plan_prototype) and, once the person confirms by a click in their own mailbox, send one quote request per make-part to the matching manufacturers. Needs the requester e-mail and user_consent; nothing is sent before the confirmation click. Returns the project id, a token to read it and the plan.

description.description: The product, what it does, size, existing prototypes or files (at least 20 characters)

quantity.description: Target quantity for the first batch (default 10)

requester_email.description: The person's e-mail: confirmation link and quotes go there

user_consent.description: true only after the user agreed that the part requests are shared with matched manufacturers

name: create_project
title: Start a prototype project
